places.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck
places.ai_summary: An iconic observation deck offering panoramic views of Singapore’s skyline, Marina Bay, and the surrounding landmarks.
places.name_english: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the breathtaking views.

places.name: Gardens by the Bay
places.ai_summary: A futuristic garden featuring the iconic Supertree Grove, Cloud Forest, and Flower Dome, showcasing nature and technology.

opening_hours.notes: Individual attractions may have different timings.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the evening light show at the Supertree Grove.

attribution.title: Supertree Grove, Gardens by the Bay, Singapore - 20120712-02
attribution.author: Shiny Things.
attribution.description: The "supertrees" tower over Gardens by the Bay, Singapore. The tallest one even has a restaurant in it. An elevated walkway spans around the trees for visitors.

places.name: Helix Bridge
places.ai_summary: A pedestrian bridge linking Marina Centre with Marina South, known for its unique double-helix structure and stunning night illumination.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed at night when it's illuminated.

places.place_tip: Walk the bridge in the evening for a romantic experience.

attribution.title: Double-Helix-Bridge
attribution.author: William Cho
attribution.description: The Double Helix Bridge at Marina Bay, entertainment district, at night.

places.name: Merlion Park
places.ai_summary: A famous park in Singapore, home to the iconic Merlion statue, which is a half-lion, half-fish creature that symbolizes Singapore's origin as a fishing village.

opening_hours.notes: The park is always open, but the Merlion statue's water spouting is turned off during maintenance.

places.place_tip: Visit early in the morning to avoid crowds and enjoy a peaceful view.

attribution.title: Singapore Merlion BCT
attribution.author: Bjørn Christian Tørrissen
attribution.description: A statue in Merlion Park near the Central Business District in downtown Singapore. The merlion is a fictional creature that is half lion and half mermaid (the fishy part, obviously). The big merlion has a small "cub" that can be seen in the background to the right of the big statue in this photo.

places.name: ArtScience Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum located within the Marina Bay Sands resort, dedicated to exploring the intersection of art, science, culture, and technology.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry is one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum's website for current exhibitions and events.

attribution.title: ArtScience Museum, Marina Bay Sands, Singapore
attribution.author: Basile Morin
attribution.description: ArtScience Museum, Marina Bay Sands, in the late afternoon, in front of the skyline of the Central Business District, Singapore. Architect : Moshe Safdie.

places.name: Esplanade – Theatres on the Bay
places.ai_summary: A performing arts center located in Marina Bay, known for its durian-shaped design and a wide range of artistic performances.

opening_hours.notes: Box office hours may vary. Check the website for performance schedules.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

attribution.title: The Esplanade – Theatres on the Bay
attribution.author: William Cho
attribution.description: The Esplanade – Theatres on the Bay, Singapore

places.name: Marina Bay Waterfront Promenade
places.ai_summary: A scenic walkway along the Marina Bay, offering stunning views of the bay, the city skyline, and the Marina Bay Sands.

opening_hours.notes: The promenade is always open, providing a beautiful walking route at any time.

places.place_tip: A great spot for a leisurely walk, jogging, or cycling.

attribution.description: Skyline of the Central Business District of Singapore, Marina Bay Singapore

places.name: Marina Barrage
places.ai_summary: A dam in Singapore built across the Marina Channel, known for its green roof and as a recreational area with stunning views of the city skyline.

opening_hours.notes: The barrage is open to visitors, but the water playground and other facilities have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop for a panoramic view of the city and the sea.

attribution.title: Marina Bay Singapore-3499
attribution.author: <bdi>Bijay Chaurasia</bdi>
attribution.description: Skyline of the Central Business District of Singapore, Marina Bay Singapore

places.name: Red Dot Design Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to contemporary design, showcasing innovative designs and ideas from around the world.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on certain public holidays. Check the website for details.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum shop for unique design items.

The Float@Marina Bay, Singapore

places.name: Fullerton Bay Hotel Rooftop View
places.ai_summary: A luxury hotel offering a rooftop view that provides a stunning panorama of the Marina Bay area, especially beautiful at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Reservations recommended for the rooftop dining.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal or a drink while taking in the breathtaking views.

places.name: Spectra Light & Water Show
places.ai_summary: A stunning show at Marina Bay Sands, featuring a dazzling display of water jets, lasers, and projections, telling a story about the wonders of Asia.

opening_hours.notes: Showtimes may vary. Check the Marina Bay Sands website for the schedule.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good viewing spot.

places.place_tip: Choose a cruise that offers dinner for a complete experience.

places.place_tip: Take a break at the food court for a variety of dining options.

places.name: Downtown Core Skyline
places.ai_summary: The Downtown Core of Singapore is the city's central business district, featuring a stunning skyline of modern skyscrapers and historic buildings.

opening_hours.notes: The skyline can be viewed at any time, but guided tours are available during the day.

places.place_tip: Visit the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark for an elevated view of the skyline.

places.name: Marina Bay City Gallery
places.ai_summary: A gallery showcasing the history, present, and future of Marina Bay, featuring interactive exhibits and stunning scale models.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on certain public holidays. Check the website for details.

places.place_tip: Engage with the interactive exhibits for a deeper understanding of Marina Bay's development.

places.name: Bay East Garden
places.ai_summary: A tranquil garden located at the eastern part of Marina Bay, featuring a wide variety of plants, flowers, and scenic waterfront views.

opening_hours.notes: The garden is open 24 hours, but the best time to visit is during the day.

places.place_tip: A perfect spot for a morning walk or a picnic with a view.

attribution.author: Shiny Things.
attribution.description: The "supertrees" tower over Gardens by the Bay, Singapore. The tallest one even has a restaurant in it. An elevated walkway spans around the trees for visitors.

places.name: Marina Bay Street Circuit (F1)
places.ai_summary: A street circuit around Marina Bay for the Formula One Singapore Grand Prix, known for its stunning city backdrop and challenging layout.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be restricted during events. Check the website for the F1 schedule.

places.place_tip: Experience the thrill of the F1 night race if visiting in September.

places.name: Singapore Flyer
places.ai_summary: A giant Ferris wheel offering breathtaking views of Singapore's skyline, Marina Bay, and beyond.

opening_hours.notes: Last ticket sales at 09:30 PM. Operating hours may vary on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Book a flight during sunset for a memorable experience.

places.name: Millenia Walk
places.ai_summary: A shopping mall located in the Marina Centre, offering a range of retail, dining, and entertainment options.

opening_hours.notes: Some stores may have different opening hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the variety of dining options available.

attribution.title: View of Millenia Singapore from the Singapore Flyer - 20150411
attribution.author: Riley from Christchurch, New Zealand.
attribution.description: A view of Millenia Singapore from the 165-metre high Singapore Flyer, a large Ferris wheel that is actually taller than the London Eye.

places.name: One Raffles Quay Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint located at One Raffles Quay, offering a stunning panoramic view of the Marina Bay area and the Singapore skyline.

opening_hours.notes: The viewpoint is always open, providing a great photo opportunity at any time.

places.place_tip: A great spot for photography enthusiasts.
